questions.q: What is the capital of El Salvador?
questions.why: It lies below a volcano.

questions.q: Which archbishop was murdered while saying Mass in 1980?
questions.why: He was made a saint in 2018.

questions.q: Which country is the smallest in Central America?
questions.why: It is also the most densely populated.

questions.q: Which currency did El Salvador adopt in 2001?
questions.why: It replaced the colón.

questions.q: Which cryptocurrency did El Salvador make legal tender in 2021?
questions.why: It was the first country to do so, and dropped it in 2025.

questions.q: Who has been President of El Salvador since 2019?
questions.why: He started a big crackdown on gangs.

questions.q: Which civil war lasted from 1980 to 1992?
questions.why: Peace accords were signed in Mexico.

questions.q: Which 1932 massacre killed thousands of peasants?
questions.why: It followed a rebellion.

questions.q: Which village was the site of a 1981 army massacre?
questions.why: About 800 civilians were killed.

questions.q: Which guerrilla front became a political party after the war?
questions.why: It was named after Farabundo Martí.

questions.q: Which Maya village was buried by volcanic ash around 600 AD?
questions.why: It is called the 'Pompeii of the Americas'.

questions.q: Which country did El Salvador fight in the 1969 Football War?
questions.why: It lasted about 100 hours.

questions.q: Which mega-prison opened in 2023 for gang members?
questions.why: It holds tens of thousands.

questions.q: Which Salvadoran poet wrote 'Poema de amor'?
questions.why: He was killed in 1975.

questions.q: Which Indigenous Pipil warrior is a symbol of resistance?
questions.why: He is said to have fought Alvarado.

questions.q: Which thick stuffed corn tortilla is the national dish?
questions.why: It has its own national day in November.

questions.q: Which ocean is El Salvador's only coast on?
questions.why: It is the only Central American country without a Caribbean coast.

questions.q: Which beach town is famous for surfing?
questions.why: It is near La Libertad.

questions.q: Which flowering plant is El Salvador's national flower?
questions.why: It is also eaten.

questions.q: Which volcano is El Salvador's tallest?
questions.why: It has a green crater lake.

questions.q: Which young volcano was called the 'Lighthouse of the Pacific'?
questions.why: It erupted almost constantly until 1966.

questions.q: What are Salvadorans called informally?
questions.why: It is a friendly nickname.

questions.q: Which route of colourful mountain towns is famous with visitors?
questions.why: Juayúa has a food festival there.

questions.q: Which large crater lake is close to San Salvador?
questions.why: It formed in a huge eruption.

questions.q: Which Maya site has a large pyramid in Chalchuapa?
questions.why: It is the country's best-known ruin.

questions.q: Which Salvadoran footballer is the country's best-known player?
questions.why: He played for Cádiz in Spain.

questions.q: Which festival celebrates the Divine Saviour each August?
questions.why: The country is named after the Saviour.

questions.q: Which festival sees men throw burning balls in Nejapa?
questions.why: It is held on 31 August.

questions.q: Which crater lake changes colour and draws visitors near Santa Ana?
questions.why: It can turn turquoise.

questions.q: Which artist from La Palma made the colourful naïve painting style famous?
questions.why: His designs are on many crafts.
